result:
The app changed its default procedure-status concept from the stand-in Medication dispense status concept to the newly published Procedure Status concept. Commit `6e8da1b` (PR #3412, ticket O3-5652) made the change.

- **Before:** `statusConceptUuid` defaulted to `167157AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA` with `statusConceptSourceType` set to `Concept set`. A TODO said to update it once a procedure-status concept set existed, and that the 167157 concept was a placeholder (CIEL "Medication dispense status").
- **After:** `statusConceptUuid` defaults to `f0d47b45-8303-4cdc-a9f2-c37135a3700f` and `statusConceptSourceType` defaults to `Answer to`. The PR body links the new concept as CIEL 170800.
- The form reads both values through `useConfig` and passes them to the concept search, so the new defaults take effect there.
- The README still lists the old defaults (`167157AAAA…` and `Concept set`), so it is out of date.
